verdict.rationale: Vercel documents 'spending controls' and budgets, but only in the scope of AI Gateway model routing (vercel-docs-35, vercel-docs-36), not as a general hard cap on overall Vercel hosting/bandwidth/compute costs. Independent community evidence directly contradicts the idea that Vercel gives reliable cost caps at the platform level: 'Waking up to a 10k vercel bill is pretty common, especially when a DDoS goes undetected' (vercel-comm-12), indicating no effective hard spending limit exists for typical infra usage. Missing for 10: documented account/team-level hard spend caps or usage kill-switches for general Vercel compute/bandwidth billing, and independent confirmation that AI Gateway budgets actually enforce hard stops rather than soft alerts.
